decision: Wave 0 must preserve the current context-isolated Electron preload/IPC/security boundaries exactly; no frozen-plan change is required.
softRisks: The __apis surface is broad and must remain narrowly scoped during later changes.
MessagePort transfers for worker-connect and helper-connection must remain limited to their existing bridges.
The Sentry preload import is a later EXCLUDE_LATER network/telemetry concern.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: BrowserWindow security settings and runtime process owners are proven from Codebase.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: web-preferences.ts sets sandbox=true, contextIsolation=true, nodeIntegration=false; main/index.ts calls app.enableSandbox(); security-restrictions.ts validates internal origins and denies unexpected navigation/windows.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Every preload exposure and corresponding main-process handler family is mapped.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Four preload exposures map to main/handlers.ts (14 handler namespaces), main/events.ts (7 event namespaces), main/shared-storage, and static appInfo.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Renderer access to privileged operations is classified and bounded.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: checkSource validates internal assets:// origins before IPC dispatch; helper/worker MessagePorts are separate from general IPC.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No unresolved IPC or security architecture risk remains before mutation.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Repository evidence shows a coherent context-isolated bridge and no frozen-plan contradiction; remaining items are soft hardening risks.

preloadExposures.name: __appInfo
preloadExposures.notes: Built from process arguments; no privileged RPC surface.

preloadExposures.name: __events
preloadExposures.notes: AFFINE_EVENT_CHANNEL_NAME and AFFINE_EVENT_SUBSCRIBE_CHANNEL_NAME dispatch through 7 event namespaces.

preloadExposures.name: __sharedStorage
preloadExposures.notes: Global state/cache bridge over the same API/event channels.

keyRepositoryFacts.fact: IPC_AND_PRELOAD_MAP.jsonl contains 4 PRELOAD_EXPOSURE, 4 IPC_EVENT_LISTENER, and 3 IPC_REGISTRATION rows.
preload/bootstrap.ts exposes __appInfo, __apis, __events, and __sharedStorage only after validating an internal URL.
main/handlers.ts registers 14 handler namespaces and checks source before dispatch.
main/events.ts registers 7 event namespaces and checks source before subscription.
